name: 43619 · Northwood, OH
findings: ZIP 43619 (Northwood) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43619 (Northwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43619 (Northwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
